segments.sn55.25:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena saraṇāni sakko kālaṅkato hoti.
segments.sn55.25:1.5: Tatra sudaṃ sambahulā sakkā saṅgamma samāgamma ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti –
segments.sn55.25:1.7: Ettha dāni ko na sotāpanno bhavissati!
segments.sn55.25:1.8: Yatra hi nāma saraṇāni sakko kālaṅkato.
segments.sn55.25:1.12: Atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn55.25:2.4: Tatra sudaṃ, bhante, sambahulā sakkā saṅgamma samāgamma ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti –
segments.sn55.25:2.6: Ettha dāni ko na sotāpanno bhavissati!
segments.sn55.25:2.7: Yatra hi nāma saraṇāni sakko kālaṅkato.
segments.sn55.25:2.8: So bhagavatā byākato – sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇoti.
segments.sn55.25:3.1: “Yo so, mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, so kathaṃ vinipātaṃ gaccheyya!
segments.sn55.25:3.2: Yañhi taṃ, mahānāma, sammā vadamāno vadeyya –
segments.sn55.25:3.3: ‘dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato’, saraṇāniṃ sakkaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
segments.sn55.25:3.4: Saraṇāni, mahānāma, sakko dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, so kathaṃ vinipātaṃ gaccheyya!
segments.sn55.25:4.1: “Idha, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe ekantagato hoti abhippasanno – itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.25:4.3: Dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … hāsapañño javanapañño vimuttiyā ca samannāgato.
segments.sn55.25:4.6: So āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn55.25:4.7: Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
segments.sn55.25:5.1: “Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe ekantagato hoti abhippasanno – itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.25:5.3: Dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … hāsapañño javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
segments.sn55.25:5.6: So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti, upahaccaparinibbāyī hoti, asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti, sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti, uddhaṃsoto hoti akaniṭṭhagāmī.
segments.sn55.25:5.7: Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
segments.sn55.25:6.1: “Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe ekantagato hoti abhippasanno – itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.25:6.3: Dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
segments.sn55.25:6.6: So tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti, sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
segments.sn55.25:6.7: Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
segments.sn55.25:7.1: “Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe ekantagato hoti abhippasanno – itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.25:7.3: Dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
segments.sn55.25:7.6: So tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo.
segments.sn55.25:7.7: Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
segments.sn55.25:8.1: “Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo na heva kho buddhe ekantagato hoti abhippasanno … pe … na dhamme … pe … na saṅghe … pe … na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato;
segments.sn55.25:8.5: api cassa ime dhammā honti – saddhindriyaṃ … pe … paññindriyaṃ.
segments.sn55.25:8.7: Tathāgatappaveditā cassa dhammā paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti.
segments.sn55.25:8.8: Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo agantā nirayaṃ agantā tiracchānayoniṃ agantā pettivisayaṃ agantā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ.
segments.sn55.25:9.1: “Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo na heva kho buddhe ekantagato hoti abhippasanno … na dhamme … pe … na saṅghe … pe … na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato;
segments.sn55.25:9.5: api cassa ime dhammā honti – saddhindriyaṃ … pe … paññindriyaṃ.
segments.sn55.25:9.8: Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo agantā nirayaṃ agantā tiracchānayoniṃ agantā pettivisayaṃ agantā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ.
segments.sn55.25:10.1: “Seyyathāpi, mahānāma, dukkhettaṃ dubbhūmaṃ avihatakhāṇukaṃ, bījāni cassu khaṇḍāni pūtīni vātātapahatāni asārādāni asukhasayitāni [asukhāpassayitāni (ka.)], devo ca na sammā [devo pana sammā (syā. kaṃ.), devo na sammā (ka.) dī. ni.2.438] dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.
segments.sn55.25:10.2: Api nu tāni bījāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyun”ti?
segments.sn55.25:10.4: “Evameva kho, mahānāma, idha dhammo durakkhāto [dvākkhāto (pī. ka.)] hoti duppavedito aniyyāniko anupasamasaṃvattaniko asammāsambuddhappavedito – idamahaṃ dukkhettasmiṃ vadāmi.
segments.sn55.25:10.6: Tasmiñca dhamme sāvako viharati dhammānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī – idamahaṃ dubbījasmiṃ vadāmi”.
segments.sn55.25:11.1: “Seyyathāpi, mahānāma, sukhettaṃ subhūmaṃ suvihatakhāṇukaṃ, bījāni cassu akhaṇḍāni apūtīni avātātapahatāni sārādāni sukhasayitāni;
segments.sn55.25:11.2: devo ca [devo cassa (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.
segments.sn55.25:11.3: Api nu tāni bījāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyun”ti?
segments.sn55.25:11.5: “Evameva kho, mahānāma, idha dhammo svākkhāto hoti suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito – idamahaṃ sukhettasmiṃ vadāmi.
segments.sn55.25:11.7: Tasmiñca dhamme sāvako viharati dhammānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī – idamahaṃ subījasmiṃ vadāmi.
segments.sn55.25:11.10: Saraṇāni, mahānāma, sakko maraṇakāle sikkhāya paripūrakārī ahosī”ti.

lines: Dukkhettaṃ nirojakaṃ, tāya eva dukkhettatāya visamaṃ hotīti āha “visamakhettan”ti.
Vātātapahatānīti cirakālaṃ vātena ceva ātapena ca upahatāni ābādhitāni.
